comment: Phase-3 CONCLUDING cells (docs/limitations_and_next_steps.md §7 items 1 and 3). Every cell keeps the promoted Good exactly as Gate-2's C2 (factor_v3 Track A + flat-0.45 reject thresholds + behavior-penalties off + vibes ON) so results are directly comparable to C2 = 47/92 = 51.1% and C1 = 21/90 = 23.3%. Cell order matters: the executor drains candidates in order. b2 (LLM-free, ~5 min/game) runs FIRST — it fail-fasts the harness and its finish times stagger the LLM games' first calls, defusing the DeepSeek batch-1 thundering herd that hung 5/15 Gate-2 games; the headline a1 cell follows. a1: Evil's belief model (its mirror of how the table perceives players, feeding blend-in proposals, teammate distancing, and the public cover plan) upgraded factor_v2 -> factor_v3 — the co-adaptation/equilibrium probe. a2: same, plus an Evil policy retuned to STARVE the rejection signal factor_v3 feeds on (approve clean teams more, stop early clean-team rejects, split bloc votes, distance more) — rejected-proposal dynamics carry most of the self-play detection signal (AUC 0.722 -> 0.539 without them), so a quieter Evil is the natural counter-adaptation. b1: frozen Evil, persona/variant bank ON (GRAIL_PROMPT_PERSONA_BANK) — does the detector gain survive a diversified speech layer, and does the role fingerprint drop (see fingerprint_classifier.py)? b2: frozen Evil, speech layer OFF (GRAIL_NO_CHAT, vibes off too since there is no chat to read) — isolates how much of the win-rate result depends on language at all. Launch: setsid/daemonized bash code/evaluation/run_gate2.sh --grid evaluation/phase3_concluding.json --runs 45 --concurrency 12 --output evaluation/phase3_concluding_runs --tag concluding
